p.s: In my opinion, I do not believe that young people enjoy life more than older people do.
First of all, younger people have to work hard to get to the stage, so they can have the experience of an older man or older woman.
Second, as a young person, you are restricted to do many things an adult can do, and finally, as an older man/woman life is open to you, you are free to do what you want.
First of all, Teenagers have to work their way up to be successful in their lives, this mean carrying many responsibilities.
I will use myself for an example; I am 16 and a half and im a senior at Woburn High School, recentley i have been hit with many responsibilites such as college.
I applied to 6 colleges, and have worked many days completing the applications.
I could have decided to not do all this work, but i want to advance.
When i grow old i want the chance to have a good future and enjoy it.
Young people do not enjoy life more than older people do.
Second, as a young person, you are restricted to do many things an adult can do.
For example, buying a car.
As a minor, a person under 18 cannot purchase an automotive vehicle without parental consent.
I am a big fan of cars, however, I ca n't purchase one until i turn 18.
Older people do not have to deal with this.
Older people can go and buy whatever they want, whenever they want, but that cant be neccessarily a good thing.
Finally, as a man or a woman get old, they find out that life is open to them.
They have finished paying the morgage for their house, and they have a good amount of money in their bank.
What is there for them to do?
They can do anything.
They could go to Florida and live the rest of their lives on a beach, or they can even stay at their house, and relax for the rest of their lives.
Younger people cannot do that.
In conclusion, Younger people dont always have it harder than older people.
Older people already went through the stage of their life where they worked hard to reach their goal.
For younger people that stage has just opened up.
